timestamp_field_resolution.issue: Card displayed 04:12 ET and 08:15 ET adjacent without field separation, reading as an inconsistency.
timestamp_field_resolution.resolution: The two instants are distinct fields, not one timestamp: market_snapshot_time_et = 04:12 (when the DK entry prices were captured); decision_time_et = 08:15 (when FORECAST_V1 was registered). Constraint satisfied: market_snapshot_time <= decision_time for every entry price on the board. The 13:40 ET reverification and 14:30 ET V3 issue are append-only delta timestamps and do not modify V1.
